{{Top|canon=Octuple turbolaser barbette}}
[[File:Octuplebatteries.jpg|thumb|right|350px|]]
An '''octuple barbette turbolaser''' was a weapons system installed on [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]].

The turbolaser cannon was marked by eight individual barrels arranged in rows of four on a barbette mounting. They were placed on the dorsal hull of the ''Imperial II''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], on each side of the command tower.
